capabilities.source: The visible capabilities field only, or a separately human-attested catalog bound to its exact UTF-8 SHA-256.
capabilities.visible_declaration_contract: One explicit typed capability signature followed by an explicit statement that both/all listed arguments are required, or an empty signature followed by an explicit statement that no arguments are required. Every declared argument is required for ACTION_READY; argument types are enforced.
capabilities.unsupported_or_ambiguous_input: Fail closed. Do not infer identifiers or required fields from free prose, task outputs, or semantic references.
capabilities.semantic_evidence_entailment: Not established by structural validation; score separately with the frozen semantic evaluator.

scope: Synthetic engineering and registered seed-17 main and ablation outputs
